name: taste-mobile
description: Art direction and design review for mobile apps in SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose and React Native/Expo, checked on a simulator.

interface.shortDescription: Art direction and design review for mobile apps.
interface.longDescription: Deals one art direction from a studied corpus of shipped apps, makes the agent commit to it in writing, then lints the code, captures the simulator and critiques the screenshots before it reports.
defaultPrompt: Build an iPhone app for a shared monthly budget, with a dealt direction.
Redesign this screen and keep the brand colours.
Review these screens and tell me what reads as a default.
